desc: 深夜蓝暗调毛笔字详情页，小宠活体从萌点到收口九镜
name: 暗调电影感小宠活体展示款

shots.intent: 暗调电影感首屏一眼立住「小宠活体」品类认知，用大标题加胶囊副标语拿下详情页第一跳
shots.textZone: 上部三分之一居中毛笔主标题带，其下一枚居中胶囊副标语位，再下一行字距拉开的拉丁 kicker 装饰行

shots.intent: 四枚同构圆孔把四条主张拆成一眼可读的矩阵，一秒传递「为什么是这只小宠」
shots.textZone: 顶部居中标题带与两侧五点簇，四孔下方各一枚等距短标签位

shots.intent: 用空荡冷清的居家角落对上右侧有伴的同机位画面，把情感缺口讲成买家自己的日常
shots.textZone: 两栏底端各一枚等距短标签位

shots.intent: 用极近距离的胡须与针毛质感替代口头形容，让毛色与健康状态自己说话
把三条上手须知排成同构拱形胶囊，先解决「我能不能养好」的疑虑
shots.textZone: 顶部短横线、居中标题带与其下一行副标语，三枚胶囊内各一条短标签，行末一行 kicker 装饰位

shots.intent: 用双栏规格表把关键信息一次交代清楚，替买家省掉一轮客服咨询
shots.textZone: 卡面顶部标题带，右栏八行标签与占位值等距排列，hairline 分隔线

shots.intent: 两行两列的编号方格把上手过程可视化，降低新手对饲养流程的抗拒
shots.textZone: 顶部居中标题带与其下 kicker 行，四格下方各一条短说明位，格角编号方块

shots.intent: 圆形加横幅加竖胶囊的三格展示把同一主体的多角度摆成可选清单，推动买家做挑选动作
shots.textZone: 顶部居中标题带与其下胶囊副标语，三格下方各一枚选项标签位

shots.intent: 仰视剪影把情绪推到高点后给出一个低摩擦动作位，收口整页而不承诺任何优惠
shots.textZone: 上部居主标题带与其下朱红 hairline，右下圆角按钮位

style.backgroundSystem: deep navy rounded panels #1B2A41 with 20px corners set on a near-black slate field #14181D, one steel-blue card variant #2C4661, white circular image wells and tall arch-capsule wells ringed in slate, hairline rules and five-dot clusters separating screens
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight 2px line rules, five-dot clusters flanking titles, 999px-radius capsule badges, circular wells with a 6px slate ring, numbered step squares with 4px corners in #8E1F24, no pictograms of animals or tools
style.lightingSystem: single soft key from the upper left at 4600K with a cool rim from the right, deep falloff into the frame edges, small catchlight in the eye, contact shadows only where the subject or vessel meets slate; infographic wells stay evenly readable at 5500K while keeping the same upper-left key direction
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent moody cinematic small-pet detail-page visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep navy panel #1B2A41, near-black slate field #14181D, steel-blue card #2C4661, clean white text #FFFFFF and one sparing vermilion accent #8E1F24; cool low-key tone; one dry-brush calligraphy display face used identically as the single main title on every screen at 32-46pt, paired with one modern geometric sans-serif for every capsule badge, caption, option label and spec row at 9-18pt, no third typeface; background system of deep navy rounded panels with 20px corners on the near-black slate field, white circular image wells with a 6px slate ring, tall arch-capsule wells and hairline rules; lighting system of a single soft key from the upper left at 4600K with a cool rim from the right, deep falloff into the frame edges, small catchlight and contact shadows only, infographic wells evenly readable at 5500K with the same upper-left key direction; surface system of black textured slate stone with clear glass vessel rims and a shallow bed of small loose glossy legume grains; layout system of centred stacked title, capsule sub-badge, five-dot hairline ornaments and numbered step squares with 4px corners; the subject held at the same slight 3/4 eye-level angle and scale on every photo screen, grounded by a contact shadow, coat pattern and proportions true to the reference and never restyled; no color palette changes, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no third typeface, no bright high-key white studio screens, no QR codes or membership patches, no invented breed names, ages, weights or health claims.
noDrift: no third typeface beyond the pinned display and text pair
no bright high-key white studio screens
no QR codes, membership patches or store stickers
no invented breed names, ages, weights or health claims
style.presentationRules: the subject held at the same slight 3/4 eye-level angle and scale on every photo screen, always seated in or beside one clear glass vessel and grounded by a contact shadow, never floating; coat pattern and body proportions true to the reference and never restyled; deep falloff at frame edges keeps the silhouette readable
style.surfaceSystem: black textured slate stone #14181D tabletop with clear glass vessel rims and a shallow bed of small loose glossy legume grains as dry substrate
style.typography: two pinned tiers only: one dry-brush calligraphy display face used identically for the single main title on every screen at 32-46pt in #FFFFFF, paired with one modern geometric sans-serif for every capsule sub-badge, caption, option label and spec row at 9-18pt; Chinese copy carried entirely as placeholders, tiny letter-spaced latin kicker lines used only as generic decoration
